items.title: New Todo Position
items.description: Choose whether new todos are added at the top or bottom of your Markdown files.

items.title: Due Reminders
items.description: Due reminders now work, even when the device is in the background.

items.title: Widgets
items.description: Widget support has been added, allowing you to view and manage your todos directly from your home screen.

items.title: Material 3 Settings
items.description: The settings screen was redesigned to follow Material 3 guidelines.

items.title: Optional Subtasks
items.description: Enable or disable subtasks from settings to keep your lists simple.

items.title: Smoother Swipes
items.description: Todo swipe actions were reworked for a cleaner gesture handling approach.
